name: explicit_not_found_code
rationale: A not-found response specifies a rejection but permits more than one exact status interpretation unless the numeric code is stated.

name: explicit_update_response_fields
rationale: State obligations about the updated item do not by themselves specify which fields the PUT response must contain.

name: explicit_login_token
rationale: An obligation that login succeeds does not establish the token-return part of a compound assertion without a stated token response.
